hyperparameters.method: Candidate pool = players who played for the team in its previous 10 games (absent rows added); classifier walk-forward by season; unconditional minutes = P(play) x E[min | play].

hypothesis: A LightGBM classifier on recent participation, days since last game and return-from-absence beats the EWMA participation rate and the incumbent's availability proxy.
limitations: Most DNPs are predictable from recent participation patterns; the rest needs the injury report.

point.result: Validation Brier 0.1207 vs EWMA rate 0.1604 (incumbent 0.1684 vs ours 0.1162 on its rows); ECE 0.0043. Unconditional minutes MAE 5.79 vs 7.28 (EWMA) and incumbent 6.77 vs ours 6.01 (-0.755 (95% CI -0.799 to -0.712)). Holdout: Brier 0.1252, MAE 5.97, incumbent diff -0.837 (95% CI -0.881 to -0.795); 80% coverage of the hurdle mixture 0.805.

question: Can a participation hurdle predict who plays without an injury report?
